mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cage_owner_approval_config (owner_account_id, confirm_required, divide_approval_required, transfer_approval_required, update_by, update_time) VALUES (#{ownerAccountId}, #{confirmRequired}, #{divideApprovalRequired}, #{transferApprovalRequired}, #{updateBy}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE confirm_required = VALUES(confirm_required), divide_approval_required = VALUES(divide_approval_required), transfer_approval_required = VALUES(transfer_approval_required), update_by = VALUES(update_by), update_time = NOW()
